## 5cff884f1d16

**Reproduced defect — advertised exact domains are not executable.** Source hash:
`3dc7d375fa334e741c22d3c1d2e1fbbba5879627d3333fbfeb99b18665ab0ade`.
The generator declares `grid_h` valid `1..15`, `grid_w` valid `1..30`, and
`palette_size` valid `1..10`, but normal generation calls `draw_int` with only
`2..12`, `2..15`, and `2..6`. At seed 0/sample 0, each of
`grid_h={1,15}`, `grid_w={1,30}`, and `palette_size={1,10}` is rejected as outside
the narrower draw range. Thus the public override contract is false even before
considering the impossible promise of UD asymmetry for a one-row grid.

The isolated audit preset also found no task-local tests and failed its strict
semantic stage because no semantic contract is declared. I did not edit this
audit target. Exact attempts, exceptions, source hash, and command are in
`checks/audit/5cff884f1d16-override-reproducer.json`; isolated-stage evidence is
under `checks/audit/5cff884f1d16-combined/`.
